# ---- german ----

# Country scope (the starter). The smallest result share among the core parts of the german merge that joined and
# haven't switched: 0 until one has joined, 1 once every joined one has switched.
te_cmg_german_lowest_dom = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_german_north_german ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_german_south_german ?= 1
			}
		}
		value = 1
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_german_north_german ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_german }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_german_north_german }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_german_north_german
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_german_south_german ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_south_german }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_german_south_german }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_german_south_german
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. How far the german merge is from its switch, 0 to 1: the lowest result share over the share at
# which the rest of a part switches. The core's while it runs; once it is complete (state 2) the lowest among
# the parts still converting, which are the late ones.
te_cmg_german_progress = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 2 }
		value = te_cmg_german_lowest_dom_all
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
	else = {
		value = te_cmg_german_lowest_dom
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
}

# Country scope. The same, 0 to 100, for the bar.
te_cmg_german_bar_pct = {
	value = te_cmg_german_progress
	multiply = 100
}

# Country scope. The standard-of-living gap alemannic's own gate reads (te_cm_sol_gate_part): the core range at
# the last census widened to take in alemannic, highest minus lowest, for the entry's description. 0 without the figures.
te_cmg_german_opt_alemannic_sol_gap = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_german
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_german
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_german_alemannic
		}
		value = var:te_cm_sol_hi_german
		min = var:te_cm_sol_german_alemannic
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_german_alemannic < var:te_cm_sol_lo_german }
			subtract = var:te_cm_sol_german_alemannic
		}
		else = {
			subtract = var:te_cm_sol_lo_german
		}
	}
}

				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_yugoslav_croat
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_yugoslav_bosniak ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bosniak }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_yugoslav_bosniak }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_yugoslav_bosniak
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (the starter). The same over every part that joined, optional and late ones included.
te_cmg_yugoslav_lowest_dom_all = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_yugoslav_serb ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_yugoslav_croat ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_yugoslav_bosniak ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_yugoslav_slovene ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_yugoslav_bulgarian ?= 1
			}
		}
		value = 1
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_yugoslav_serb ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_serb }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_yugoslav_serb }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_yugoslav_serb
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_yugoslav_croat ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_croat }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_yugoslav_croat }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_yugoslav_croat
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_yugoslav_bosniak ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bosniak }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_yugoslav_bosniak }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_yugoslav_bosniak
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_yugoslav_slovene ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_slovene }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_yugoslav_slovene }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_yugoslav_slovene
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_yugoslav_bulgarian ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bulgarian }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_yugoslav_bulgarian }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_yugoslav_bulgarian
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. How far the yugoslav merge is from its switch, 0 to 1: the lowest result share over the share at
# which the rest of a part switches. The core's while it runs; once it is complete (state 2) the lowest among
# the parts still converting, which are the late ones.
te_cmg_yugoslav_progress = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:te_cm_state_yugoslav ?= 2 }
		value = te_cmg_yugoslav_lowest_dom_all
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
	else = {
		value = te_cmg_yugoslav_lowest_dom
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
}

# Country scope. The same, 0 to 100, for the bar.
te_cmg_yugoslav_bar_pct = {
	value = te_cmg_yugoslav_progress
	multiply = 100
}

# Country scope. The standard-of-living gap slovene's own gate reads (te_cm_sol_gate_part): the core range at
# the last census widened to take in slovene, highest minus lowest, for the entry's description. 0 without the figures.
te_cmg_yugoslav_opt_slovene_sol_gap = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_yugoslav
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_yugoslav
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_yugoslav_slovene
		}
		value = var:te_cm_sol_hi_yugoslav
		min = var:te_cm_sol_yugoslav_slovene
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_yugoslav_slovene < var:te_cm_sol_lo_yugoslav }
			subtract = var:te_cm_sol_yugoslav_slovene
		}
		else = {
			subtract = var:te_cm_sol_lo_yugoslav
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. The standard-of-living gap bulgarian's own gate reads (te_cm_sol_gate_part): the core range at
# the last census widened to take in bulgarian, highest minus lowest, for the entry's description. 0 without the figures.
te_cmg_yugoslav_opt_bulgarian_sol_gap = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_yugoslav
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_yugoslav
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_yugoslav_bulgarian
		}
		value = var:te_cm_sol_hi_yugoslav
		min = var:te_cm_sol_yugoslav_bulgarian
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_yugoslav_bulgarian < var:te_cm_sol_lo_yugoslav }
			subtract = var:te_cm_sol_yugoslav_bulgarian
		}
		else = {
			subtract = var:te_cm_sol_lo_yugoslav
		}
	}
}

# ---- czechoslovak ----

# Country scope (the starter). The smallest result share among the core parts of the czechoslovak merge that joined and
# haven't switched: 0 until one has joined, 1 once every joined one has switched.
te_cmg_czechoslovak_lowest_dom = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_czechoslovak_czech ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_czechoslovak_slovak ?= 1
			}
		}
		value = 1
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_czechoslovak_czech ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_czech }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_czechoslovak_czech }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_czechoslovak_czech
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_czechoslovak_slovak ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_slovak }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_czechoslovak_slovak }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_czechoslovak_slovak
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
	}
}

# ---- british ----

# Country scope (the starter). The smallest result share among the core parts of the british merge that joined and
# haven't switched: 0 until one has joined, 1 once every joined one has switched.
te_cmg_british_lowest_dom = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_british_scottish ?= 1
			}
		}
		value = 1
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_british_scottish ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_scottish }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_british_scottish }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_british_scottish
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (the starter). The same over every part that joined, optional and late ones included.
te_cmg_british_lowest_dom_all = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_british_scottish ?= 1
			}
		}
		value = 1
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_british_scottish ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_scottish }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_british_scottish }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_british_scottish
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. How far the british merge is from its switch, 0 to 1: the lowest result share over the share at
# which the rest of a part switches. The core's while it runs; once it is complete (state 2) the lowest among
# the parts still converting, which are the late ones.
te_cmg_british_progress = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:te_cm_state_british ?= 2 }
		value = te_cmg_british_lowest_dom_all
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
	else = {
		value = te_cmg_british_lowest_dom
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
}

# Country scope. The same, 0 to 100, for the bar.
te_cmg_british_bar_pct = {
	value = te_cmg_british_progress
	multiply = 100
}

# Country scope. How far the american merge is from its switch, 0 to 1: the lowest result share over the share at
# which the rest of a part switches. The core's while it runs; once it is complete (state 2) the lowest among
# the parts still converting, which are the late ones.
te_cmg_american_progress = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:te_cm_state_american ?= 2 }
		value = te_cmg_american_lowest_dom_all
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
	else = {
		value = te_cmg_american_lowest_dom
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
}

# Country scope. The same, 0 to 100, for the bar.
te_cmg_american_bar_pct = {
	value = te_cmg_american_progress
	multiply = 100
}

# Country scope. The years the american merge has waited on a vanilla entry (the census stops at
# te_cm_wait_cap_years), for its wait condition and status row. 0 before the census sets the counter.
te_cmg_american_wait_years_so_far = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_cm_wait_years_american }
		value = var:te_cm_wait_years_american
	}
}

# Country scope. The standard-of-living gap afro_american's own gate reads (te_cm_sol_gate_part): the core range at
# the last census widened to take in afro_american, highest minus lowest, for the entry's description. 0 without the figures.
te_cmg_american_opt_afro_american_sol_gap = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_american
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_american
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_american_afro_american
		}
		value = var:te_cm_sol_hi_american
		min = var:te_cm_sol_american_afro_american
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_american_afro_american < var:te_cm_sol_lo_american }
			subtract = var:te_cm_sol_american_afro_american
		}
		else = {
			subtract = var:te_cm_sol_lo_american
		}
	}
}

	multiply = 100
}

# Country scope. The years british pops have been held and accepted together for the anglophone merge, up to the
# te_cm_years_tier2 its tier asks for: the figure its start condition shows. 0 before the census sets the counter.
te_cmg_anglophone_british_years_so_far = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_anglophone_british }
		value = var:te_cm_years_anglophone_british
		max = te_cm_years_tier2
	}
}

# Country scope. The standard-of-living gap anglo_canadian's own gate reads (te_cm_sol_gate_part): the core range at
# the last census widened to take in anglo_canadian, highest minus lowest, for the entry's description. 0 without the figures.
te_cmg_anglophone_opt_anglo_canadian_sol_gap = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_anglophone
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_anglophone
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_anglophone_anglo_canadian
		}
		value = var:te_cm_sol_hi_anglophone
		min = var:te_cm_sol_anglophone_anglo_canadian
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_anglophone_anglo_canadian < var:te_cm_sol_lo_anglophone }
			subtract = var:te_cm_sol_anglophone_anglo_canadian
		}
		else = {
			subtract = var:te_cm_sol_lo_anglophone
		}
	}
}

	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_nordestino ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_paulista ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_amazonic ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_sulista ?= 1
			}

				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_nordestino }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_brazilian_nordestino }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_brazilian_nordestino
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_paulista ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_paulista }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_brazilian_paulista }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_brazilian_paulista
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_amazonic ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_amazonic }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_brazilian_amazonic }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_brazilian_amazonic
			}
			else = {

				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sulista }

				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_brazilian_sulista

			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_nordestino ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_paulista ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_amazonic ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_sulista ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_afro_brazilian ?= 1
			}
		}
		value = 1
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_nordestino ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_nordestino }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_brazilian_nordestino }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_brazilian_nordestino
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_paulista ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_paulista }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_brazilian_paulista }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_brazilian_paulista
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_amazonic ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_amazonic }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_brazilian_amazonic }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_brazilian_amazonic
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_sulista ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sulista }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_brazilian_sulista }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_brazilian_sulista
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_afro_brazilian ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_afro_brazilian }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_brazilian_afro_brazilian }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_brazilian_afro_brazilian
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. How far the brazilian merge is from its switch, 0 to 1: the lowest result share over the share at
# which the rest of a part switches. The core's while it runs; once it is complete (state 2) the lowest among
# the parts still converting, which are the late ones.
te_cmg_brazilian_progress = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:te_cm_state_brazilian ?= 2 }
		value = te_cmg_brazilian_lowest_dom_all
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
	else = {
		value = te_cmg_brazilian_lowest_dom
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
}

# Country scope. The same, 0 to 100, for the bar.
te_cmg_brazilian_bar_pct = {
	value = te_cmg_brazilian_progress
	multiply = 100
}

# Country scope. The years the brazilian merge has waited on a vanilla entry (the census stops at
# te_cm_wait_cap_years), for its wait condition and status row. 0 before the census sets the counter.
te_cmg_brazilian_wait_years_so_far = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_cm_wait_years_brazilian }
		value = var:te_cm_wait_years_brazilian
	}
}

# Country scope. The standard-of-living gap afro_brazilian's own gate reads (te_cm_sol_gate_part): the core range at
# the last census widened to take in afro_brazilian, highest minus lowest, for the entry's description. 0 without the figures.
te_cmg_brazilian_opt_afro_brazilian_sol_gap = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_brazilian
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_brazilian
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_brazilian_afro_brazilian
		}
		value = var:te_cm_sol_hi_brazilian
		min = var:te_cm_sol_brazilian_afro_brazilian
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_brazilian_afro_brazilian < var:te_cm_sol_lo_brazilian }
			subtract = var:te_cm_sol_brazilian_afro_brazilian
		}
		else = {
			subtract = var:te_cm_sol_lo_brazilian
		}
	}
}

# ---- platine ----

# Country scope (the starter). The smallest result share among the core parts of the platine merge that joined and
# haven't switched: 0 until one has joined, 1 once every joined one has switched.
te_cmg_platine_lowest_dom = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_platine_platinean ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_platine_argentine ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_platine_uruguayan ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_platine_paraguayan ?= 1
			}
		}
		value = 1
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_platine_platinean ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_platinean }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_platine_platinean }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_platine_platinean
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_platine_argentine ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_argentine }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_platine_argentine }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_platine_argentine
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_platine_uruguayan ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uruguayan }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_platine_uruguayan }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_platine_uruguayan
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_platine_paraguayan ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_paraguayan }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_platine_paraguayan }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_platine_paraguayan
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
	}
}

				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_min }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_chinese_min }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_chinese_min
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_chinese_hakka ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_hakka }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_chinese_hakka }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_chinese_hakka
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. How far the chinese merge is from its switch, 0 to 1: the lowest result share over the share at
# which the rest of a part switches. The core's while it runs; once it is complete (state 2) the lowest among
# the parts still converting, which are the late ones.
te_cmg_chinese_progress = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:te_cm_state_chinese ?= 2 }
		value = te_cmg_chinese_lowest_dom_all
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
	else = {
		value = te_cmg_chinese_lowest_dom
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
}

# Country scope. The same, 0 to 100, for the bar.
te_cmg_chinese_bar_pct = {
	value = te_cmg_chinese_progress
	multiply = 100
}

# ---- arab ----

# Country scope (the starter). The smallest result share among the core parts of the arab merge that joined and
# haven't switched: 0 until one has joined, 1 once every joined one has switched.
te_cmg_arab_lowest_dom = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_arab_maghrebi ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_arab_misri ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_arab_mashriqi ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_arab_bedouin ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_arab_yemenite ?= 1
			}
		}
		value = 1
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_arab_maghrebi ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_maghrebi }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_arab_maghrebi }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_arab_maghrebi
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_arab_misri ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_misri }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_arab_misri }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_arab_misri
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_arab_mashriqi ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_mashriqi }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_arab_mashriqi }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_arab_mashriqi
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_arab_bedouin ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bedouin }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_arab_bedouin }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_arab_bedouin
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_arab_yemenite ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yemenite }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_arab_yemenite }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_arab_yemenite
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. The standard-of-living gap sudanese's own gate reads (te_cm_sol_gate_part): the core range at
# the last census widened to take in sudanese, highest minus lowest, for the entry's description. 0 without the figures.
te_cmg_arab_opt_sudanese_sol_gap = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_arab
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_arab
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_arab_sudanese
		}
		value = var:te_cm_sol_hi_arab
		min = var:te_cm_sol_arab_sudanese
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_arab_sudanese < var:te_cm_sol_lo_arab }
			subtract = var:te_cm_sol_arab_sudanese
		}
		else = {
			subtract = var:te_cm_sol_lo_arab
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. The standard-of-living gap haratin's own gate reads (te_cm_sol_gate_part): the core range at

		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_azerbaijani }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (the starter). The same over every part that joined, optional and late ones included.
te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_lowest_dom_all = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_oghuz_turkic_turkish ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_oghuz_turkic_turkmen ?= 1
			}
		}
		value = 1
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_oghuz_turkic_turkish ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_turkish }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_oghuz_turkic_turkish }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_oghuz_turkic_turkish
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_azerbaijani }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_oghuz_turkic_turkmen ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_turkmen }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_oghuz_turkic_turkmen }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_oghuz_turkic_turkmen
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. How far the oghuz_turkic merge is from its switch, 0 to 1: the lowest result share over the share at
# which the rest of a part switches. The core's while it runs; once it is complete (state 2) the lowest among
# the parts still converting, which are the late ones.
te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_progress = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:te_cm_state_oghuz_turkic ?= 2 }
		value = te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_lowest_dom_all
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
	else = {
		value = te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_lowest_dom
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
}

# Country scope. The same, 0 to 100, for the bar.
te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_bar_pct = {
	value = te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_progress
	multiply = 100
}

# Country scope. The standard-of-living gap turkmen's own gate reads (te_cm_sol_gate_part): the core range at
# the last census widened to take in turkmen, highest minus lowest, for the entry's description. 0 without the figures.
te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_opt_turkmen_sol_gap = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_oghuz_turkic
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_oghuz_turkic
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_oghuz_turkic_turkmen
		}
		value = var:te_cm_sol_hi_oghuz_turkic
		min = var:te_cm_sol_oghuz_turkic_turkmen
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_oghuz_turkic_turkmen < var:te_cm_sol_lo_oghuz_turkic }
			subtract = var:te_cm_sol_oghuz_turkic_turkmen
		}
		else = {
			subtract = var:te_cm_sol_lo_oghuz_turkic
		}
	}
}

# ---- hindustani ----

# Country scope (the starter). The smallest result share among the core parts of the hindustani merge that joined and
# haven't switched: 0 until one has joined, 1 once every joined one has switched.
te_cmg_hindustani_lowest_dom = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_avadhi ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_bundeli ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_chhattisgarhi ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_bageli ?= 1
			}
		}
		value = 1
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_avadhi ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_avadhi }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_hindustani_avadhi }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_hindustani_avadhi
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_bundeli ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bundeli }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_hindustani_bundeli }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_hindustani_bundeli
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_chhattisgarhi ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_chhattisgarhi }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_hindustani_chhattisgarhi }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_hindustani_chhattisgarhi
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_bageli ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bageli }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_hindustani_bageli }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_hindustani_bageli
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (the starter). The same over every part that joined, optional and late ones included.
te_cmg_hindustani_lowest_dom_all = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_avadhi ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_bundeli ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_chhattisgarhi ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_bageli ?= 1
			}
		}
		value = 1
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_avadhi ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_avadhi }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_hindustani_avadhi }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_hindustani_avadhi
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_bundeli ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bundeli }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_hindustani_bundeli }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_hindustani_bundeli
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_chhattisgarhi ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_chhattisgarhi }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_hindustani_chhattisgarhi }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_hindustani_chhattisgarhi
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_bageli ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bageli }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_hindustani_bageli }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_hindustani_bageli
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. How far the hindustani merge is from its switch, 0 to 1: the lowest result share over the share at
# which the rest of a part switches. The core's while it runs; once it is complete (state 2) the lowest among
# the parts still converting, which are the late ones.
te_cmg_hindustani_progress = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:te_cm_state_hindustani ?= 2 }
		value = te_cmg_hindustani_lowest_dom_all
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
	else = {
		value = te_cmg_hindustani_lowest_dom
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
}

# Country scope. The same, 0 to 100, for the bar.
te_cmg_hindustani_bar_pct = {
	value = te_cmg_hindustani_progress
	multiply = 100
}

				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_filipino_tagalog ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tagalog }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_filipino_tagalog }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_filipino_tagalog
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_filipino_ilocano ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ilocano }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_filipino_ilocano }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_filipino_ilocano
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (the starter). The same over every part that joined, optional and late ones included.

# Country scope. How far the filipino merge is from its switch, 0 to 1: the lowest result share over the share at
# which the rest of a part switches. The core's while it runs; once it is complete (state 2) the lowest among
# the parts still converting, which are the late ones.
te_cmg_filipino_progress = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:te_cm_state_filipino ?= 2 }
		value = te_cmg_filipino_lowest_dom_all
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
	else = {
		value = te_cmg_filipino_lowest_dom
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
}

# Country scope. The same, 0 to 100, for the bar.
te_cmg_filipino_bar_pct = {
	value = te_cmg_filipino_progress
	multiply = 100
}

# ---- nguni ----

# Country scope (the starter). The smallest result share among the core parts of the nguni merge that joined and
# haven't switched: 0 until one has joined, 1 once every joined one has switched.
te_cmg_nguni_lowest_dom = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_nguni_nguni ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_nguni_zulu ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_nguni_xhosa ?= 1
			}
		}
		value = 1
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_nguni_nguni ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_nguni }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_nguni_nguni }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_nguni_nguni
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_nguni_zulu ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_zulu }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_nguni_zulu }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_nguni_zulu
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_nguni_xhosa ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_xhosa }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_nguni_xhosa }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_nguni_xhosa
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
	}
}

			OR = {

				global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_cm_italian ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_spanish ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_portuguese ?= 1
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_french ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_french }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_latin_french }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_latin_french
			}
			else = {
				max = 0

		}
		if = {

				global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_cm_italian ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_italian }
			}

				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_latin_cm_italian
			}
			else = {

				global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_portuguese ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_romanian ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_platinean ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_cm_platine ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_argentine ?= 1

# Country scope. The years french pops have been held and accepted together for the latin merge, up to the
# te_cm_years_tier3 its tier asks for: the figure its start condition shows. 0 before the census sets the counter.
te_cmg_latin_french_years_so_far = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_latin_french }
		value = var:te_cm_years_latin_french
		max = te_cm_years_tier3
	}
}

# Country scope. The standard-of-living gap romanian's own gate reads (te_cm_sol_gate_part): the core range at
# the last census widened to take in romanian, highest minus lowest, for the entry's description. 0 without the figures.
te_cmg_latin_opt_romanian_sol_gap = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_latin
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_latin
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_latin_romanian
		}
		value = var:te_cm_sol_hi_latin
		min = var:te_cm_sol_latin_romanian
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_latin_romanian < var:te_cm_sol_lo_latin }
			subtract = var:te_cm_sol_latin_romanian
		}
		else = {
			subtract = var:te_cm_sol_lo_latin
		}
	}
}

# the last census widened to take in platinean, highest minus lowest, for the entry's description. 0 without the figures.

# ---- pan_slavic ----

# Country scope (the starter). The smallest result share among the core parts of the pan_slavic merge that joined and
# haven't switched: 0 until one has joined, 1 once every joined one has switched.
te_cmg_pan_slavic_lowest_dom = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_cm_czechoslovak ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav ?= 1
			}
		}
		value = 1
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_east_slavic }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_cm_czechoslovak ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_czechoslovak }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_pan_slavic_cm_czechoslovak }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_pan_slavic_cm_czechoslovak
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_yugoslav }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (the starter). The same over every part that joined, optional and late ones included.
te_cmg_pan_slavic_lowest_dom_all = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_cm_czechoslovak ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_polish ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_slovene ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_bulgarian ?= 1
			}
		}
		value = 1
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_east_slavic }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_cm_czechoslovak ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_czechoslovak }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_pan_slavic_cm_czechoslovak }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_pan_slavic_cm_czechoslovak
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_yugoslav }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_polish ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_polish }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_pan_slavic_polish }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_pan_slavic_polish
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_slovene ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_slovene }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_pan_slavic_slovene }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_pan_slavic_slovene
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_bulgarian ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bulgarian }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_pan_slavic_bulgarian }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_pan_slavic_bulgarian
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. How far the pan_slavic merge is from its switch, 0 to 1: the lowest result share over the share at
# which the rest of a part switches. The core's while it runs; once it is complete (state 2) the lowest among
# the parts still converting, which are the late ones.
te_cmg_pan_slavic_progress = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:te_cm_state_pan_slavic ?= 2 }
		value = te_cmg_pan_slavic_lowest_dom_all
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
	else = {
		value = te_cmg_pan_slavic_lowest_dom
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
}

# Country scope. The same, 0 to 100, for the bar.
te_cmg_pan_slavic_bar_pct = {
	value = te_cmg_pan_slavic_progress
	multiply = 100
}

# Country scope. The years cm_east_slavic pops have been held and accepted together for the pan_slavic merge, up to the
# te_cm_years_tier3 its tier asks for: the figure its start condition shows. 0 before the census sets the counter.
te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic_years_so_far = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic }
		value = var:te_cm_years_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic
		max = te_cm_years_tier3
	}
}

# Country scope. The years cm_czechoslovak pops have been held and accepted together for the pan_slavic merge, up to the
# te_cm_years_tier3 its tier asks for: the figure its start condition shows. 0 before the census sets the counter.

	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_pan_slavic_cm_czechoslovak }
		value = var:te_cm_years_pan_slavic_cm_czechoslovak
		max = te_cm_years_tier3
	}
}

# Country scope. The years cm_yugoslav pops have been held and accepted together for the pan_slavic merge, up to the

		limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav }
		value = var:te_cm_years_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav
		max = te_cm_years_tier3
	}
}

# Country scope. The standard-of-living gap polish's own gate reads (te_cm_sol_gate_part): the core range at
# the last census widened to take in polish, highest minus lowest, for the entry's description. 0 without the figures.
te_cmg_pan_slavic_opt_polish_sol_gap = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_pan_slavic
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_pan_slavic
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_pan_slavic_polish
		}
		value = var:te_cm_sol_hi_pan_slavic
		min = var:te_cm_sol_pan_slavic_polish
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_pan_slavic_polish < var:te_cm_sol_lo_pan_slavic }
			subtract = var:te_cm_sol_pan_slavic_polish
		}
		else = {
			subtract = var:te_cm_sol_lo_pan_slavic
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. The standard-of-living gap slovene's own gate reads (te_cm_sol_gate_part): the core range at
# the last census widened to take in slovene, highest minus lowest, for the entry's description. 0 without the figures.
te_cmg_pan_slavic_opt_slovene_sol_gap = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_pan_slavic
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_pan_slavic
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_pan_slavic_slovene
		}
		value = var:te_cm_sol_hi_pan_slavic
		min = var:te_cm_sol_pan_slavic_slovene
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_pan_slavic_slovene < var:te_cm_sol_lo_pan_slavic }
			subtract = var:te_cm_sol_pan_slavic_slovene
		}
		else = {
			subtract = var:te_cm_sol_lo_pan_slavic
		}
	}
}

		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_pan_turkic_crimean_tatar < var:te_cm_sol_lo_pan_turkic }
			subtract = var:te_cm_sol_pan_turkic_crimean_tatar
		}
		else = {
			subtract = var:te_cm_sol_lo_pan_turkic
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. The standard-of-living gap caucasian_turk's own gate reads (te_cm_sol_gate_part): the core range at
# the last census widened to take in caucasian_turk, highest minus lowest, for the entry's description. 0 without the figures.
te_cmg_pan_turkic_opt_caucasian_turk_sol_gap = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_pan_turkic
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_pan_turkic
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_pan_turkic_caucasian_turk
		}
		value = var:te_cm_sol_hi_pan_turkic
		min = var:te_cm_sol_pan_turkic_caucasian_turk
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_pan_turkic_caucasian_turk < var:te_cm_sol_lo_pan_turkic }
			subtract = var:te_cm_sol_pan_turkic_caucasian_turk
		}
		else = {
			subtract = var:te_cm_sol_lo_pan_turkic
		}
	}
}

# ---- pan_malay ----

# Country scope (the starter). The smallest result share among the core parts of the pan_malay merge that joined and
# haven't switched: 0 until one has joined, 1 once every joined one has switched.
te_cmg_pan_malay_lowest_dom = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_malay_cm_indonesian ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_malay_filipino ?= 1
			}
		}
		value = 1
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_malay_cm_indonesian ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_indonesian }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_pan_malay_cm_indonesian }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_pan_malay_cm_indonesian
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_malay_filipino ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_filipino }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_pan_malay_filipino }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_pan_malay_filipino
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (the starter). The same over every part that joined, optional and late ones included.
te_cmg_pan_malay_lowest_dom_all = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_malay_cm_indonesian ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_malay_filipino ?= 1
			}
		}
		value = 1
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_malay_cm_indonesian ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_indonesian }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_pan_malay_cm_indonesian }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_pan_malay_cm_indonesian
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_malay_filipino ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_filipino }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_pan_malay_filipino }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_pan_malay_filipino
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. How far the pan_malay merge is from its switch, 0 to 1: the lowest result share over the share at
# which the rest of a part switches. The core's while it runs; once it is complete (state 2) the lowest among
# the parts still converting, which are the late ones.
te_cmg_pan_malay_progress = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:te_cm_state_pan_malay ?= 2 }
		value = te_cmg_pan_malay_lowest_dom_all
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
	else = {
		value = te_cmg_pan_malay_lowest_dom
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
}

# Country scope. The same, 0 to 100, for the bar.
te_cmg_pan_malay_bar_pct = {
	value = te_cmg_pan_malay_progress
	multiply = 100
}

# Country scope. The years cm_indonesian pops have been held and accepted together for the pan_malay merge, up to the
# te_cm_years_tier3 its tier asks for: the figure its start condition shows. 0 before the census sets the counter.
te_cmg_pan_malay_cm_indonesian_years_so_far = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_pan_malay_cm_indonesian }
		value = var:te_cm_years_pan_malay_cm_indonesian
		max = te_cm_years_tier3
	}
}

# Country scope. The years filipino pops have been held and accepted together for the pan_malay merge, up to the
# te_cm_years_tier3 its tier asks for: the figure its start condition shows. 0 before the census sets the counter.
te_cmg_pan_malay_filipino_years_so_far = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_pan_malay_filipino }
		value = var:te_cm_years_pan_malay_filipino
		max = te_cm_years_tier3
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_east_african_swahili ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_east_african_nyamwezi ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_east_african_sukuma ?= 1
			}
		}
		value = 1
		if = {

				global_var:te_cm_joined_east_african_swahili ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_swahili }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_east_african_swahili }
				max = global_var:te_cm_dom_east_african_swahili
			}
			else = {
				max = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_east_african_nyamwezi ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_nyamwezi }
			}

		}
		if = {

				global_var:te_cm_joined_east_african_sukuma ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sukuma }
			}

			subtract = var:te_cm_sol_east_african_yao
		}

	}
